name: home-illustration
prompt:
Create original 2D editorial sports illustration for Chinese youth sports training brand 乐秒 / LEMIAO. Professional, crisp, energetic flat vector-like print artwork, confident simplified shapes, subtle flat screenprint texture, natural athletic anatomy, sophisticated independent sports brand. Signal orange #F45125, cream #FFF4DA, forest green #234837 and charcoal #202624. No 3D, no gradients, no glossy rendering, no cute mascot, no text, letters, logos or watermark. These are production app assets, not a UI mockup.
Wide horizontal 3:2 art. Background is solid vivid orange #F45125 across entire canvas. RIGHT half: dynamic 2D illustrated East Asian child in cream sports shirt and forest-green shorts jumping with an orange basketball, an elegant large cream track curve beneath and one small green cone. Large simplified clear forms readable at 170px. LEFT 48% is completely calm flat orange negative space reserved for headline overlay. Energetic full-body posture, cheerful focused face, editorial sports poster, restrained color palette.
